plan.title: Add Linux status measurement collection while preserving cold-cache refusal

criteria.description: Linux collector uses monotonic launch-through-reap wall time and wait4 peak RSS KiB-to-byte conversion; rejects failed, signaled, timed-out or invalid status results. Injected and real-child tests cover failure paths.
Existing warm/first-run sample contracts and cold-cache rejection remain; Linux small synthetic workload verifies actual warm/first-run output and explicit collection semantics.

limitations: E03a prerequisite only. No reset backend or cold-cache enablement; E03b owns reset/probe/start ordering and reader controls. One small workload is not the P11 thirty-sample performance result. Linux wait4 peak RSS is not simultaneous process-tree RSS and Linux timings are not directly compared to historical macOS time-l timings.
